Chesapeake Bay from Sandy Point to North Beach-
457 PM EDT Sun Sep 27 2026

...SMALL CRAFT ADVISORY IN EFFECT THROUGH MONDAY AFTERNOON...

.REST OF THIS AFTERNOON...NW winds 20 kt with gusts to 30 kt. Waves
3 ft. Numerous showers. 
.TONIGHT...NW winds 15 to 20 kt. Gusts up to 30 kt... diminishing to
20 kt late. Waves 2 to 3 ft. Scattered showers. Patchy fog. Vsby
1 to 3 NM. 
.MON...NW winds 5 to 10 kt. Gusts up to 20 kt until late afternoon.
Waves 1 to 2 ft. 
.MON NIGHT...NW winds 5 to 10 kt. Waves 1 ft or less. 
.TUE...NW winds 5 kt. Waves flat. 
.TUE NIGHT...W winds around 5 kt. Waves flat. 
.WED...NW winds around 5 kt...becoming S. Waves 1 ft or less. 
.THU...S winds 5 to 10 kt. Waves 1 to 2 ft.
